problem_statement: The MA claim-security branch can falsely complete if it proves denial, appeal, clinical criteria, or payment integrity while the network is unavailable in practice, the directory lists inactive providers, behavioral-health access is nominal, or MA encounter data cannot definitively identify payment denials.
row_contract: At least one current MA contract/service/provider-month row must join HSD/ACC pass-fail or exception, MPF/API/directory listing, active provider and appointment availability, behavioral-health access where relevant, access complaint or failed ZIP/specialty marker, definitive denied-claim status, payment/service restoration, clinical correctness, subgroup denominator, and source lineage before certification.
false_pass_blocks: No HSD/ACC pass: a network-adequacy table or automated criteria check is an access predicate, not proof that care was available.
No exception pass: an approved network exception must preserve the exception reason, provider supply file, alternative access pattern, and beneficiary burden.
No provider-directory pass: MPF/API presence does not prove the provider is active, accepts the enrollee, or can offer a timely appointment.
No ghost-network pass: inactive providers and non-serving listed providers must be visible at provider-location level.
No behavioral-health workforce pass: nominal workforce or specialty counts do not prove active Medicare/MA managed-care access.
No complaint-only pass: complaints trigger review but do not measure the denominator of silent access failure.
No encounter-adjustment pass: adjustment codes without a definitive denied-claim indicator cannot certify payment-denial incidence.
No paid-claims pass: paid encounter volume cannot substitute for denied, abandoned, out-of-network, or never-scheduled care.
No API/MPF pass: directory publication/update timing does not prove real-time accuracy or appointment capacity.
No remedy pass: access restoration requires an actual provider appointment/service/payment restoration date.
audit_refactor_note: Rev0378 also refactors prior MA audit scripts so they resolve their latest active bridge/workbench rather than failing merely because the current revision advanced.
primary_blocker_after_rev0378: No acquired current provider/request/payment row yet joins network adequacy, directory accuracy, active provider/appointment availability, definitive denied-claim status, and clinical/remedy restoration.
